# make the climate prior more uninformative (increase of variance) if the recent age lies in younger holocene
if( recent & min(age) >= 2000 ){
    prior.recent$sd.pann <- prior.recent$sd.pann*2
    prior.recent$sd.tmp <- prior.recent$sd.tmp*2
}

# For large shape parameter the gamma distribution converges to normal distribution with mean μ = shape/rate and variance σ^2 = shape/(rate)^2
shape1 <- seq(0.1,50000,by=0.1)
rate1 <- shape1/prior.recent$mean.pann # includes the expectation value
rate2 <- sqrt(shape1)/prior.recent$sd.pann # includes the standard deviation

# intersection of rate1 and rate2
intersect_id <- which.min(abs((rate2-rate1) - 0))
shape <- shape1[intersect_id] 
rate  <- rate2[intersect_id]
